svg.title: Everything Is Connected — Intersecting Domains
svg.desc: Five overlapping circles with Everything Is Connected at the center. All 58 source terms preserved. Economic development & human security: Poverty, Unemployment, Economic Recovery, Forced Migration, Informal Economies, Economic Inequality, Diminished Economic Growth, Cycles of Exploitation, Lost Education, Social Fragmentation, Water Insecurity, Food Insecurity; Societal trust & integrity: No Public Trust, Creation of Parallel Economies, Loss of Hope, Destabilization of Communities, Psychological Impact, Subversion, Malign Influence, Deterioration of Public Services, Loss of Social Cohesion; Governance & democracy: No Transparency, No Rule of Law, Silencing Dissent, Peace and Security, Impunity, Kleptocracies and Autocracies, Undermining Electoral Integrity, Violation of Human Rights, Social Polarization, Weak Democracy, Media Manipulation, No Accountability; Environment security & global threats: Chemical and Biological Weapons, Pandemics, Counterfeit Medicines, Water Contamination, Resource Exploitation, Nuclear Proliferation, Terrorism and Terrorist Financing, Environmental Degradation, Air and Ocean Pollution, Climate Change, Conservation; Criminal activities: Cybercrime, Cigarette Smuggling, Illicit Supply Chains, Drugs Trafficking, Arms Trafficking, Human Trafficking, Money Laundering/TBML, Art and Antiquities Theft, Poaching, Counterfeit Goods, Consumer Fraud, Trafficking Critical Minerals, Corruption, Illegal Organ Trade

g.aria-label: Source: ICAIE · supplied “Impacts of Illicit Economies” graphic.
g.title: Source: ICAIE · supplied “Impacts of Illicit Economies” graphic.

g.aria-label: Overlaps illustrate interconnected domains; they do not encode measured intersections.
g.title: Overlaps illustrate interconnected domains; they do not encode measured intersections.
